checked.method: GET PBDB diversity.csv endpoint for Metazoa genera, 0-66 Ma, stage resolution; GET taxa/single.json name=Metazoa

variables_present: per-stage counts of genera (columns X_Ft, X_bL, X_FL, X_bt, sampled_in_bin, implied_in_bin, n_occs) with interval ages
occurrence-level data via occs/list for subsampling

datasets.scope: The taxa record for Metazoa reports noc 1,361,166 occurrences. The diversity endpoint returned 22 rows (Greenlandian to the 66 Ma boundary) with columns interval_no, interval_name, max_ma, min_ma, X_Ft, X_bL, X_FL, X_bt, sampled_in_bin, implied_in_bin, n_occs; e.g. Late Pleistocene n_occs 40,842 and Piacenzian n_occs 20,263.
datasets.evidence: Both API calls returned HTTP 200 with the fields above. Download is open without authentication. Licence not read.

summary: The PBDB open API serves per-stage genus counts, boundary-crosser style origination/extinction inputs and raw occurrences (about 1.36 million for Metazoa), so the variables for a later-Phanerozoic origination-versus-extinction comparison are obtainable; sampling standardization has to be done by the tester.
next_step: Pre-register the interval scheme and subsampling method, pull occs/list for Cenozoic marine invertebrates, and compute per-interval rates in a script (not done here).
obstacles_confirmed: Raw PBDB counts do not remove the Pull of the Recent; standardization is not provided by the API.
